correctness.rationale: From \(5\sigma(n)=9n\), oddness, squarefulness, and \(3\nmid n\) are proved explicitly. Therefore \(\nu_3(\sigma(n))=2\). Multiplicativity plus LTE gives the exact local contributions, and the residue cases are exhaustive. Exact rational abundancy checks and an independent finite regression checker support, but do not replace, the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The exact 3-adic allocation is a structural sieve on a longstanding unresolved abundancy problem. It converts a known existence congruence into a complete one-or-two carrier law and removes a full singleton residue class modulo 54. This directly constrains future factor-chain and search arguments on the same object.
